name: moong
sowing_season: Kharif: June–July | Summer: March–April after wheat, potato or mustard (irrigated)
soil: Well-drained loam or sandy loam, pH 6.5–7.5; avoid saline and waterlogged soil

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.irrigation: Summer crop: sow after a pre-sowing irrigation. Kharif: sow after good rain.
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 40 kg DAP per acre. Treat seed with Trichoderma 4 g per kg, then Rhizobium + PSB 5 g per kg.
tips: Seed rate 8–10 kg per acre (10–12 kg for the summer crop)

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Leaves and branches grow; root nodules fix nitrogen.
stages.irrigation: Summer crop: every 10–12 days. Kharif: drain standing water.
tips: Pull out yellow mosaic plants as soon as you see them

stages.name: Flowering
stages.irrigation: A light irrigation if dry — flowers and pods need moisture.
tips: Put up 10 yellow sticky traps per acre for whitefly

stages.name: Pod Formation / Pod Filling
stages.irrigation: Last irrigation at pod filling (summer crop).
tips: For pod borer spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC 0.3 ml/litre

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
tips: Pick ripe pods in 2–3 rounds to avoid shattering
After picking, plough the plants into the soil as green manure

common_pests.name: Whitefly
common_pests.symptoms: Tiny white flies under leaves; spreads yellow mosaic
common_pests.control: Yellow sticky traps 10 per acre; Thiamethoxam 25 WG 0.2 g/litre

common_pests.name: Pod borer (Maruca)
common_pests.symptoms: Flowers and pods webbed together with caterpillars inside

common_diseases.name: Yellow mosaic
common_diseases.symptoms: Bright yellow patches on leaves, few pods
common_diseases.control: Resistant varieties; pull out infected plants; control whitefly

common_diseases.name: Cercospora leaf spot
common_diseases.symptoms: Brown spots with grey centres on leaves
